name: Mezametara, Boku ga Kawaii Onna no Ko
original_name: 目覚めたら、ボクが可愛い女の子
source:
Ryou is a normal student, but one day he awakes in the morning and discovers... That he had transformed into a Girl from night to morning!!

His sister will try to get him to get back to his previous self.... but the experiment fails and he is unable to come back to be a men.

Now he will start living as a woman, but... will he be able to comeback to his previous self, or when he would be able to do it he won't want it anymore...?
translation:
水野凉原本只是一名普通学生，某天早晨醒来却发现……自己竟在一夜之间变成了女孩！！

妹妹想方设法帮他恢复原状……实验却以失败告终，他再也无法变回男人。

从此，他将以女性身份开始生活。然而……他究竟能否找回原来的身体？即使将来真的能够恢复，到那时，他还会愿意变回去吗……？
